sections.title: Shared case display building blocks
sections.what: Holds the small visual pieces for the case screens: a confidence badge, a progress bar, document cards, family member cards, verification summaries, issue cards, a survey record card, a next action card, a timeline, and standard loading, empty and error messages.
sections.why: Keeps the look and wording the same on every screen that shows these items.
sections.watch_out: The confidence badge is marked as high at 95 or above, so a change to that cut-off point changes how every badge looks.

summary: A shared set of small display building blocks used across the case screens, such as badges, progress, cards, timeline and loading or error states.
purpose: Provides one consistent look for common items like documents, family members, verification results and status messages.
why: Likely reason: many pages show the same kinds of items, so the shared pieces keep wording and layout consistent. Reason not fully stated in the code.
how: Each exported component takes data as props and returns a block of markup. Some read translated text. The verification and timeline pieces also convert raw data into friendly wording before showing it. Loading and error pieces provide standard status messages.
inputs: Props such as a document, a family member, a survey record, a verification item, timeline events, or a numeric value for the confidence badge and progress bar.
outputs: Visual blocks shown on the case pages, including links to other pages.
risks: Several lines are cut off in the source, so some component bodies cannot be checked. The progress bar divides by the total, so a total of zero would give a broken width.
debug: If a card looks wrong, check the data passed in from the calling page. If progress looks off, check the done and total values. If wording is wrong, check the translation helper functions.
